medications.name: Lisinopril
medications.instructions: Take 1 tablet every morning with a full glass of water. Maintain consistent fluid intake.
medications.purpose: High Blood Pressure (Hypertension) management and kidney protection.

medications.name: Metformin HCl
medications.instructions: Take 1 tablet twice daily with meals (breakfast & dinner) to reduce stomach discomfort.
medications.purpose: Blood sugar control for Type 2 Diabetes.

medications.name: Atorvastatin
medications.instructions: Take 1 tablet at bedtime. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking this medication.
medications.purpose: Cholesterol lowering and cardiovascular arterial protection.

medications.name: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)
medications.instructions: Take 1 softgel daily at lunchtime with food containing healthy fats.
medications.purpose: Bone density support & immune health for osteopenia.

doseLogs.notes: Taken with breakfast glass of water.

appointments.address: 742 Evergreen Terrace, Suite 300, Medical Arts Pavilion
appointments.reasonForVisit: 6-Month Comprehensive Hypertension & ECG Follow-up. Review Lisinopril response.

appointments.doctorNotes: Please bring recent 14-day home blood pressure log and current pill boxes.
